M-IBR-001.definition_zh: 真理只有一个：'真理不会与真理相冲突，而是彼此印证。'当哲学论证与经典文本表面冲突时，问题不在真理本身，而在诠释——要么论证有缺陷，要么文本被误读。要害有三：其一，'双方各自为真'优先于'二选一'——把冲突当作对理解力的指控而非对某一方的定罪，拒绝在证实误读之前牺牲任何一方权威；其二，冲突必须被定位到表达层——哲学用必然论证说话，经文用面向大众的修辞与想象说话，二者本就是同一实在的两种分辨率，错配的表达方式才是冲突之源；其三，诠释层校准双向进行——既可修正论证的缺陷，也可重读文本的语境，校准不是和稀泥而是找到那个能让双方同时为真的重新表述。分析任何两套权威体系（科学与宗教、实证与规范、数据与直觉、两个学科范式）的冲突时，先做'不可通约性检查'：双方证明标准不同不等于结论矛盾。方法论签名：真理不会与真理相冲突——冲突不在世界里，在你的理解里。
M-IBR-001.definition_en: There is one truth: 'truth does not oppose truth but accords with it and bears witness to it.' When philosophical demonstration and scriptural text seem to clash, the fault lies not in truth itself but in interpretation—either the demonstration is defective or the text misread. Three essentials: first, 'both are true' precedes 'pick one'—treat the conflict as an indictment of your understanding, not a verdict on either authority, and refuse to sacrifice either before a misreading is proven; second, the conflict must be located at the level of expression—philosophy speaks in necessary demonstration, scripture speaks in rhetoric and imagination addressed to the multitude, and the two are resolutions of one and the same reality; mismatched registers, not opposed facts, are the source of the clash; third, interpretive calibration runs both ways—one may repair the defective argument or re-read the text in context, and calibration is not mush but the reframing under which both sides come out true simultaneously. When analyzing any conflict of authorities (science and religion, empirical and normative, data and intuition, rival paradigms), run the incommensurability check first: different standards of proof do not amount to contradictory conclusions. Signature: truth does not oppose truth—the conflict is not in the world but in your understanding.
representative_cases_zh: 《原则问题决定书》的合法化论证：沙里亚命令人以理性思考（'你们要思考'类经文数十处），哲学推理正是这一命令的完成——因此哲学不仅是允许的，更是宗教义务；表面的敌对源于把'面向大众的修辞表达'当成了经文的唯一含义。整个论证就是一次'冲突再定位'：把哲学与宗教的对立重写为'命令与履行命令'的统一。
《矛盾的矛盾》的立场预设：全书开篇即声明哲学家对其体系内的证明是诚实的（穆斯林不得指其为蓄意说谎），二十题的每题先以最强形式重建安萨里的论证再行反驳——'双方各自为真'的方法论前提使反驳成为诠释之争而非立场谩骂。
世界永恒之争的诠释层化解：安萨里判'世界永恒'为异端，伊本·鲁世德不直接反判，而论证经文并未对世界的时间开端作出可断言的陈述——把'哲学结论 vs 经文断言'的冲突重新表述为'哲学结论 vs 经文沉默'，冲突在诠释层消解。
反例警示：诠释层化解不能无限下探——当经文确有明确断言（如身体复活）时，必须承认是哲学论证越界而非重读文本；没有'明确断言/隐喻表达'的甄别步骤，'真理不相冲突'就退化为对强势一方的无限妥协。
representative_cases_en: The legalization argument in Faṣl al-Maqāl: scripture commands reflection (dozens of 'consider and reflect' verses), and philosophical demonstration is precisely the fulfillment of that command—philosophy is thus not merely permitted but obligatory; the apparent hostility stems from treating popular rhetorical expressions as the sole sense of scripture. The whole argument is a conflict relocation: rewriting the philosophy-religion opposition as 'command and its fulfillment.'

The presumption of good faith in the Incoherence of the Incoherence: the book opens by declaring that philosophers argue honestly within their own systems (a Muslim may not accuse them of deliberate falsehood), and each of the twenty questions first reconstructs al-Ghazali's argument in its strongest form before rebutting it—the methodological premise 'both are true' turns refutation into a dispute of interpretation rather than a war of positions.

Dissolving the eternity-of-the-world clash at the interpretive level: al-Ghazali condemned 'the world's eternity' as heresy; Averroes did not simply counter-condemn but argued that scripture makes no assertible statement about the world's temporal beginning—reframing 'philosophical conclusion vs scriptural assertion' as 'philosophical conclusion vs scriptural silence,' and the clash dissolves in interpretation.

Counter-case: interpretive dissolution has a floor—where scripture does make an explicit assertion (bodily resurrection, say), one must concede the philosophical argument has overstepped rather than re-read the text; without a step distinguishing 'explicit assertion' from 'metaphorical expression,' truth-does-not-oppose-truth degenerates into unlimited capitulation to the stronger side.
modern_applications_zh: 科学与信仰/价值观的对话设计：先各自确认证明标准与适用域，再谈结论冲突——大多数'冲突'止步于标准错配
跨学科整合：把'学科打架'重构为'同一对象的不同分辨率'（经济学与心理学对'理性'之争），在诠释层找统一表述
组织治理：规章（律法层）与专家判断（演示层）显式分工，写明各自适用域，避免'用章程否决专业结论'的错配冲突
AI 对齐与模型冲突仲裁：当模型输出与安全准则冲突时，先区分'准则明文禁止'与'准则沉默'——沉默域才允许诠释层裁量
modern_applications_en: Science-faith/values dialogue design: confirm each side's standard of proof and domain before comparing conclusions—most 'conflicts' stop at standard mismatch
Interdisciplinary integration: recast disciplinary quarrels as different resolutions of one object (economics vs psychology on 'rationality') and seek a unifying formulation at the interpretive level

Governance: explicit division of labor between rules (legal layer) and expert judgment (demonstrative layer), with domains written down, avoiding mismatch conflicts like 'using the charter to veto professional conclusions'

AI alignment and arbitration of model conflicts: when model output clashes with safety policy, first distinguish 'explicitly forbidden by policy' from 'policy-silent'—interpretive discretion is licensed only in the silent zone

M-IBR-002.definition_zh: 同一真理须按受众的认知能力用三种方法表达：演示（burhān，由自明前提出发的逻辑必然论证，面向哲人）、辩证（jadal，以对方公认前提出发的论辩，面向神学家）、修辞（khiṭāba，诉诸想象与情感的说服，面向大众）。要害有三：其一，错配即灾祸且是双向的——把演示推理讲给大众，会把他们从修辞确定的安稳中抛入怀疑却无力抵达必然性，等于亲手拆毁其信仰而给不了替代物；把修辞当演示使用，则用想象冒充论证，堵塞了通往必然知识的路；其二，受众分层先于表达选择——先判定对象处于哪一认知层级（受何种训练、以何为依据），再选择表达形式，顺序不可颠倒；其三，每层保留上升通道——修辞引向辩证、辩证引向演示，低层表达不是终点而是阶梯，为愿意爬升的人留出路径。传播任何复杂结论前，先给受众分层，再选方法。方法论签名：方法必须匹配能力，错配的表达比沉默更有害。
M-IBR-002.definition_en: One truth must be expressed by three methods matched to cognitive capacity: demonstration (burhān, necessary inference from self-evident premises, for philosophers), dialectic (jadal, argument from premises the interlocutor already accepts, for theologians), and rhetoric (khiṭāba, persuasion through imagination and feeling, for the multitude). Three essentials: first, mismatch is disaster in both directions—giving demonstration to the multitude dislodges them from rhetorical certainty into doubt without the power to reach necessity, demolishing their faith while supplying nothing in its place; using rhetoric as demonstration lets imagination impersonate argument and blocks the road to necessary knowledge; second, audience stratification precedes expression choice—first determine the audience's cognitive level (trained in what, resting on what), then pick the register; the order cannot be reversed; third, each level preserves an ascent channel—rhetoric points to dialectic, dialectic to demonstration; the lower register is a rung, not a terminus, leaving a path for those willing to climb. Before communicating any complex conclusion, stratify the audience, then choose the method. Signature: the method must match the capacity; a mismatched expression harms more than silence.
representative_cases_zh: 伊本·鲁世德本人即三线作战：对宫廷与法学家写阿拉伯语法理著作（《法理精义》以类比推理链条示人），对同侪哲人写逐行评注（大/中评注只面对训练有素者），对一般信众在《原则问题决定书》中只用经文与共识自证——同一个'哲学合法'的立场，三种表达并行不悖，且他明确拒绝把评注内容公开讲授给未受训练者。
《原则问题决定书》的训诫条款：他明文指出把辩证的或修辞的论证用于哲人、或把演示推理讲给大众'都会造成伤害而非益处'——并据此批评当时的神学家用大众修辞手段（流行宣道士的说教）去处理本应演示的问题，把两套受众搅在一起，制造了社会的信仰失序。
评注体系的受众编码：小评注（提要）与中评注（释义）为正在攀登的学生准备，大评注（逐行穷尽疑难）只为已通过前两阶的专家存在——三级评注本身就是受众分层的文本工程学实现，等于给知识产品内置了'分级阅读指导'。
反例警示：上升通道若被切断，分层就变成隔离——他警告说辞令家若'用锁把真理关在门外'，大众将永远停留在想象层；分层传播的目的不是垄断真理，而是让每一层的人都能安全地站在自己的台阶上并看得见上一阶。
representative_cases_en: Averroes himself fought on three lines: legal treatises in Arabic for court and jurists (displaying analogical chains in Bidāyat al-Mujtahid), line-by-line commentaries for fellow philosophers (long and middle commentaries only for the trained), and scripture-and-consensus arguments for ordinary believers in Faṣl al-Maqāl—one stance on philosophy's legitimacy, three registers, no contradiction; and he expressly refused to lecture commentary material to the untrained.

The admonitory clause in Faṣl al-Maqāl: he states in so many words that using dialectical or rhetorical arguments with philosophers, or demonstrative ones with the multitude, 'does harm rather than good'—and on this ground criticizes the theologians of his day for handling problems that demand demonstration with popular rhetorical means (the sermons of popular preachers), mixing the audiences and producing social disorder in faith.

The commentary system as audience encoding: short (paraphrase) and middle (explanation) commentaries serve students on the climb; the long commentary (line-by-line exhaustion of difficulties) exists only for experts who have passed the first two tiers—the three-tier commentary is precisely audience stratification implemented as textual engineering, a built-in graded-reading guide for knowledge products.

Counter-case: sever the ascent channel and stratification becomes segregation—he warns that if the rhetoricians 'lock truth out with a key,' the multitude will remain forever at the level of imagination; the point of stratified communication is not to monopolize truth but to let each tier stand safely on its own rung and see the next.
modern_applications_zh: 科普写作：同一研究给同行论文、政策简报、大众文章三个版本，且大众版保留'想深入者由此进'的路径指引
风险管理沟通：对内用模型与不确定性区间说话，对外用确定性语言与行动指令——错配（对公众讲概率论）会制造恐慌
产品设计：新手引导用叙事与演示，进阶文档用推导与参数——按用户能力分层而非按功能罗列
组织变革沟通：给高管讲机制推演，给中层讲操作步骤，给全员讲意义叙事；把演示推理下放给全员是变革失败的常见根因
modern_applications_en: Science communication: one study, three deliverables—paper, policy brief, popular article—with the popular version keeping a 'go deeper from here' pointer
Risk communication: models and uncertainty intervals internally, certainty language and action directives externally—mismatch (lecturing probability theory to the public) manufactures panic
Product design: narrative onboarding for novices, derivation and parameters for advanced docs—stratify by user capability, not feature inventory

Change management: mechanism arguments for executives, operational steps for middle managers, meaning-narrative for all staff; cascading demonstration-level reasoning to everyone is a common root of failed transformations

M-IBR-003.definition_zh: 针对安萨里的偶因论（火不烧棉，是'真主在火中造烧'，因果只是恒常伴随），伊本·鲁世德重立：事物有其本性（ṭabīʿa），因与果是本质关联，火产生燃烧是必然的。要害有三：其一，必然性是知识的先决条件——若因不必然生果，则归纳失去依据、预测失去可能、经验科学退化为对偶然事件的报道，'知识'一词失去所指；他反过来指控安萨里：否认事物本性的人'也就否认了知识本身的首要前提'；其二，从可理解性反推——世界之可理解正因为其中存在稳定的因果结构，否认内在因果性等于宣布世界不可理喻，这与'真主的智慧显现于因果秩序'的教义自相矛盾：一个没有必然性的世界恰恰不配'被智慧地创造'；其三，必然因果与神圣作为可以共存——造物主经由事物的稳定本性持续运作，而非每个瞬间重新发明世界；承认事物的内在因果性不是否认造物主，而是确认造物主的创造方式。这是科学思维的形而上学前提：可预测性要求因果必然。方法论签名：宁可要一个可理解的必然世界，不要一个不可理解的任意世界。
M-IBR-003.definition_en: Against al-Ghazali's occasionalism (fire does not burn cotton; God creates the burning in it, causation being mere constant conjunction), Averroes reasserts: things have natures (ṭabīʿa); cause and effect are essentially connected; fire produces burning by necessity. Three essentials: first, necessity is the precondition of knowledge—if causes did not necessitate effects, induction would lose its ground, prediction its possibility, and empirical science would degrade into reporting of accidental events, leaving the word 'knowledge' without a referent; he turns the charge on al-Ghazali: whoever denies the natures of things 'denies the primary premises of knowledge itself'; second, the argument from intelligibility—the world is intelligible precisely because stable causal structure runs through it; denying intrinsic causality declares the world unintelligible, contradicting the doctrine that God's wisdom is displayed in the order of causes: a world without necessity is exactly what would be unworthy of 'wise creation'; third, necessary causation and divine agency coexist—the Creator operates through the stable natures of things rather than reinventing the world at each instant; affirming intrinsic causality is not denying God but affirming how God creates. This is the metaphysical precondition of scientific thinking: predictability requires causal necessity. Signature: prefer an intelligible necessary world to an unintelligible arbitrary one.
representative_cases_zh: 《矛盾的矛盾》第十七题的逐层检验：他对安萨里的棉-火例证作切片分析——若'烧'只是火出现时的伴随事件，则'把棉靠近火会取暖''用水灭火会有效'这类一切经验规则都失去合理性保证；他列举医疗、农业、技艺诸领域的实践，指出没有一种实践能在偶因论下自圆其说。
奠基拉丁自然规律概念：通过12-13世纪翻译运动，'事物本性产生必然结果'的命题进入拉丁西方，经大阿尔伯特与阿奎那发展为'自然被赋予权能'（natural potentia）学说——阿奎那《神学大全》论奇迹时明确区分'自然原因的作用'与'神圣全能的直接干预'，为近代'自然规律'（law of nature）概念预留了形而上学地基。
与安萨里之'习俗'概念的正面对决：安萨里把宇宙秩序称作真主的'习俗'（sunna/'āda），暗示秩序可被随时更改；伊本·鲁世德回应：一个每天需要重新立法的宇宙不是有序的宇宙——把必然性还给世界，才同时把'智慧'还给了创造者。
反例警示：必然论若无边界会滑向决定论宿命——伊本·鲁世德坚持必然性属于'本性层面'而非'每一个体事件层面'（本性可被阻断，如火被水浇灭），这与后来休谟式'恒常联结'的怀疑论恰成两端；混淆这两层，必然论就成了否认干预与例外的僵硬决定论。
representative_cases_en: The layer-by-layer test in Question 17: he dissects al-Ghazali's cotton-fire example—if 'burning' is a mere concomitant of fire's presence, then every practical rule ('cotton near fire warms,' 'water extinguishes fire') loses its rational warrant; he surveys medicine, agriculture, and the crafts, showing no practice can justify itself under occasionalism.

Grounding the Latin concept of laws of nature: through the twelfth-thirteenth-century translations, the proposition 'natures produce necessary effects' entered the Latin West and developed, via Albert the Great and Aquinas, into the doctrine of natural potentia—Aquinas's Summa, treating miracles, explicitly distinguishes 'the action of natural causes' from 'direct divine intervention,' laying the metaphysical ground for the later concept of laws of nature.

The head-on duel with al-Ghazali's 'custom': al-Ghazali calls cosmic order God's 'custom' (sunna/'āda), hinting the order can be altered at will; Averroes replies that a universe needing fresh legislation every day is not an ordered universe—restoring necessity to the world simultaneously restores 'wisdom' to its creator.

Counter-case: necessitarianism without boundaries slides into fatalist determinism—Averroes holds necessity belongs to the level of natures, not of every individual event (natures can be blocked, as fire is quenched by water), standing at the opposite pole from Humean skepticism about constant conjunction; conflating the two levels turns necessitarianism into a rigid determinism that denies intervention and exception.
modern_applications_zh: 科学方法论教学：区分'相关性报道'与'因果机制说明'——观察恒常伴随不等于掌握因果，但建立机制模型的目标不可放弃
政策评估：坚持机制论证，拒绝'用了之后变好了'式前后归因；无机制的政策主张在因果必然论下不具证据资格
AI 可解释性：把黑箱模型的'输入-输出并置'重构为可检验的因果链，是偶因论批判的现代翻版
产品与增长分析：'转化率提升'必须附因果机制（哪个环节改变了用户哪个行为），恒常伴随式归因是增长谎言的温床
modern_applications_en: Methodology teaching: distinguish correlational report from causal-mechanistic explanation—observed constant conjunction is not grasped causation, but building mechanism models remains the goal

Policy evaluation: demand mechanism arguments, refuse before-after attribution of the 'we tried it and things improved' kind; mechanism-free policy claims carry no evidential standing under causal necessitarianism
AI explainability: reconstructing a black-box model's input-output juxtaposition into testable causal chains is the modern rerun of the occasionalism critique
Product and growth analytics: 'conversion improved' must come with a mechanism (which step changed which user behavior); constant-conjunction attribution is the breeding ground of growth lies

M-IBR-004.definition_zh: 流传的经典常被中间解释层污染：新柏拉图主义者把亚里士多德讲成流溢论者，注疏者的注疏被当作原著。方法是对一切二手转述存疑，回到最接近源头的文本，重建原作者的论证结构本身。要害有三：其一，解释层剥离工程——把'通行的X'分解为'原作者说的'与'历代解释者添加的'两个清单，逐条标注每条教义的首次出现与传播链，凡找不到原著依据的即判定为'混入物'；其二，原典权威高于注疏权威——他论证《论原因》（Liber de Causis）并非亚里士多德所作而是普罗克洛斯的改写，主张'亚里士多德的学说是最高的，纵使有错，也当如对待医典中的盖伦一样解释和辩护，而非抛弃'——但辩护的对象是亚里士多德本身，不是'被 traditio 污染的亚里士多德'；其三，偏离须有成因解释——发现通行解释偏离原典时，追问偏离是谁、为何、何时引入的，把思想史从'观念罗列'变成'污染源追踪'。任何领域都有'被注疏遮蔽的原典'问题。方法论签名：读被转述的思想，不如读思想本身；解释链每长一节，误差就复利一次。
M-IBR-004.definition_en: Transmitted classics are polluted by interpretive strata: the Neoplatonists made Aristotle an emanationist, and commentators' commentaries came to be read as the original. The method: doubt every secondhand account, return to the text nearest the source, and reconstruct the original's own argumentative structure. Three essentials: first, the stripping operation—decompose 'the prevailing X' into two lists, 'what the author said' and 'what successive interpreters added,' annotating for each doctrine its first appearance and transmission chain; anything without grounding in the original is ruled an import; second, the authority of the source text outranks the authority of its commentators—he demonstrated that the Liber de Causis was a Proclean paraphrase, not Aristotle, and held that 'Aristotle's doctrine is the summit of human intellect; where it seems at fault, it must be explained and defended as one does Galen in medicine, not discarded'—but what is defended is Aristotle himself, not the tradition-polluted Aristotle; third, deviations demand causal explanation—on finding a prevailing interpretation at odds with the source, ask who introduced the deviation, why, and when, turning intellectual history from an inventory of ideas into a pollution-source traceback. Every field has its classics buried under commentary. Signature: reading what is said about a thought is inferior to reading the thought; each added link in the transmission chain compounds the error.
representative_cases_zh: 《论原因》的作者甄别：他通过评注逐点论证这部当时被当作'亚里士多德神学'的著作实为普罗克洛斯《神学要目》的改写——一次以文本内部证据（概念体系、论证风格、与《元素神学》的对应）完成的文献学'作者鉴定'，直接改变了拉丁西方对'亚里士多德主义'边界的理解。
系统性的'去流溢化'审计：他把'自上而下的流溢序列'（太一→理智→灵魂）从亚里士多德的宇宙论中整体剥离，论证亚里士多德只有'永恒旋转的天体'与'不动的推动者'，没有流溢层级——此后他的评注成为'真正的亚里士多德'的权威版本，即但丁所说的'以评注阐释亚里士多德者'。
哲学史上的'指称甄别'：他在《矛盾的矛盾》中逐题指出安萨里所批的'哲学家'实为法拉比与伊本·西那的新柏拉图主义化版本，而非亚里士多德本人——'你要反驳的是谁'必须先于'你如何反驳'，先甄别靶子再开火。
反例警示：回到原典不等于原教旨主义——他承认亚里士多德会有错误（并以'须如医典般解释与辩护'处理），方法的目标是'准确理解原作者'而非'原作者永远正确'；把'回到原典'变成'回到经文不可错'，就从文献学方法退化为信仰声明。
representative_cases_en: Attributing the Liber de Causis: in his commentary he argued point by point that this work, then taken as 'Aristotle's theology,' was in fact a paraphrase of Proclus's Elements of Theology—an internal-evidence attribution (conceptual apparatus, argumentative style, correspondence with the Elements) that directly changed the Latin West's understanding of the boundary of 'Aristotelianism.'

The systematic de-emanationization audit: he stripped the top-down emanation sequence (the One → intellect → soul) out of Aristotle's cosmology wholesale, showing that Aristotle has only eternally rotating heavens and an unmoved mover, no emanation hierarchy; his commentaries thereafter served as the authoritative version of 'the real Aristotle'—Dante's 'he who commented Aristotle.'

Referential screening in the history of philosophy: in the Incoherence of the Incoherence he points out, question by question, that the 'philosophers' al-Ghazali attacked were the Neoplatonized versions of al-Farabi and Ibn Sina, not Aristotle himself—'whom you refute' must precede 'how you refute'; screen the target before firing.

Counter-case: return-to-source is not fundamentalism—he concedes Aristotle may err (treating apparent faults 'as one does Galen,' by explanation and defense), and the method aims at accurate understanding of the author, not the author's infallibility; converting 'return to the source' into 'return to the inerrant text' degrades a philological method into a confession of faith.
modern_applications_zh: 领域学习：读一手论文而非教科书转述，识别教科书'标准化叙事'——每个学科都有被简化掉的原始争论
组织知识管理：追溯决策依据到原始数据与原始会议记录，防止'注疏的注疏'（转述的纪要、摘要的摘要）成为事实来源
LLM 时代信息素养：追问引用链，警惕模型生成内容成为'无源注疏'；引用要打穿到最初出版物
学术史与思想史研究：把'X认为Y'改写为'X在哪篇文本哪一段以何种论证认为Y'——污染源追踪是文献学的通用操作系统
modern_applications_en: Domain learning: read primary papers over textbook paraphrases and flag each field's 'standardized narrative'—every discipline has original debates simplified away

Organizational knowledge management: trace decisions back to raw data and original minutes, keeping 'commentaries of commentaries' (paraphrased minutes, summaries of summaries) from becoming the source of record
AI-era information literacy: chase citation chains; guard against model-generated content becoming sourceless commentary; citations must punch through to the original publication
History of ideas: rewrite 'X believed Y' as 'X, in which text and passage, argued Y how'—pollution-source traceback is the universal operating system of philology

M-IBR-005.definition_zh: 首创三级评注体系：大评注（逐段引用原文词句+穷举既有注释家之间的疑难与分歧+给出裁决与己解）、中评注（连贯的逐段释义转述）、小评注（全篇提要撮要）。同一文本按用途加工成三种精度，形成从入门提要到专业穷尽的可攀爬阶梯。要害有三：其一，粒度即产品——不是把一种'终极解读'写到底，而是把同一内容按读者需求建成'分辨率序列'，每种精度都是完整可用的独立产品；其二，跨层一致性约束——各层结论一致、术语统一、立场同一，只变粒度不变观点，使读者从任意一层进入都不会被误导；其三，高层级显式标记未决争议——大评注穷举'注释家们如何分歧'并给出裁决理由，为争议留档，这既是学术诚实也是下层引用的接口。这套体系使同一文本同时服务于初学者、执业教师与专业研究者。方法论签名：知识精加工的本质不是写一种最好的版本，而是建一个分辨率的阶梯。
M-IBR-005.definition_en: His signature invention: the three-tier commentary—long commentary (verbatim lemmatized text + exhaustive treatment of difficulties and disagreements among existing commentators + his own adjudication), middle commentary (continuous running paraphrase), short commentary (summary of the whole). One text is processed into three resolutions by use, forming a climbable ladder from primer to professional exhaustiveness. Three essentials: first, granularity is the product—not one 'ultimate reading' pushed to the end, but the same content built into a 'resolution sequence' by reader need, each tier a complete, independently usable artifact; second, cross-tier consistency—conclusions, terminology, and positions hold identical across tiers; only resolution varies, so a reader entering at any tier is never misled; third, the top tier flags open disputes explicitly—the long commentary exhausts 'how the commentators disagree' and adjudicates with reasons, archiving controversy while providing citation hooks for lower tiers. The system lets one text serve beginners, practicing teachers, and professional researchers simultaneously. Signature: the essence of knowledge refinement is not writing one best version but building a ladder of resolutions.
representative_cases_zh: 《论灵魂》三评注并存：同一文本的大、中、小三种评注同时存在且各有完整传世抄本——中世纪书业与大学课程因此得以分层：艺学院低年级用小/中评注，高级研讨用大评注；托莱多译者在拉丁化时也按需求选择层级翻译，三级评注直接塑造了欧洲大学的课程分层。
大评注的体例创新：先引原文词句（lemma），再列'注释家们在此如何分歧'（如阿弗罗迪西亚的亚历山大与泰米修斯对主动理智的解释之争），最后给出自己的裁决与论证——这使大评注不仅是释义，更是'争议的法庭记录'，后世的疏证传统（corpus variorum）即由此发端。
小评注的独立生存能力：许多小评注在拉丁西方以独立教科书形态流传（如《论天》小评注被译为 De Caelo 的标准教学用本），证明最低层级也能独立承载完整知识——'提要'不是残缺版，而是另一种完备。
反例警示：三层的成本是三倍维护——后世同一著作出现'评注互相矛盾'的失败案例（各层更新不同步导致结论漂移）；若无'高层裁决、下层跟随'的更新协议，分辨率阶梯会退化为三个互相打架的版本。
representative_cases_en: Three commentaries on De Anima coexisting: long, middle, and short commentaries on one text, each with complete manuscript traditions—medieval book production and university curricula stratified accordingly: arts-faculty undergraduates used the short and middle commentaries, advanced seminars the long; Toledo translators likewise picked tiers by need when Latinizing, so the three-tier system directly shaped European curricular stratification.

The formal innovation of the long commentary: quote the lemmatized text, then assemble 'how the commentators disagree here' (e.g., Alexander of Aphrodisias vs Themistius on the active intellect), then give his own adjudication with reasons—the long commentary is thus not paraphrase but a 'court record of controversy,' the fountainhead of the later variorum tradition.

The short commentary's independent viability: many short commentaries circulated in the Latin West as standalone textbooks (the short commentary on De Caelo became a standard teaching text), proving the lowest tier can carry complete knowledge on its own—a summary is not a defective edition but another kind of completeness.

Counter-case: three tiers cost triple maintenance—later works failed when commentaries contradicted one another (tiers updated out of sync, conclusions drifting); without an update protocol of 'top tier adjudicates, lower tiers follow,' a resolution ladder degenerates into three mutually brawling versions.
modern_applications_zh: 技术文档体系：README / 教程 / API 深度详解是同一产品的三级精度，且需维护跨层术语与结论一致
课程设计：导论-进阶-研讨的同一主题分辨率序列，研讨层显式列出学界未决争议
开源项目文档：README、设计文档（RFC）、逐行注释的三层维护协议——裁决在 RFC 层，注释跟随
知识库与 LLM 应用：为同一知识建立'一句话摘要—结构化释义—全文证据'三级索引，RAG 检索按用户层级选分辨率
modern_applications_en: Documentation systems: README / tutorial / deep API reference as three resolutions of one product, with cross-tier terminological and conclusion consistency maintained
Curriculum design: intro-advanced-seminar sequences on one theme, with the seminar tier explicitly listing open scholarly disputes
Open-source docs: a maintenance protocol across README, design docs (RFCs), and inline comments—adjudication lives at the RFC tier; comments follow
Knowledge bases and LLM applications: index the same knowledge at three tiers—one-line summary, structured paraphrase, full-text evidence—and let RAG pick resolution by user level

M-IBR-006.definition_zh: 反驳一个体系，不引入外部标准，而是进入对方体系内部，用对方自己的前提和标准推出对方结论不成立。伊本·鲁世德回应安萨里的《哲学家的矛盾》时，采取完全同构的作业方式：逐题对勘、每一反驳都援引对方文本而非外部权威，并指出安萨里自己的标准若贯彻到底会反噬其凯拉姆神学。要害有三：其一，内部批判优先于外部批判——用对方不承认的前提取得的'胜利'不构成反驳，只构成立场宣示；只有从对方前提出发的归谬才有裁决力；其二，最强形式重构是入场券——先以对方最强的形式完整重建其论证，再在其内部寻找自我应用失败的点（标准不能适用于自身、前提推出相反结论），否则只是击打稻草人；其三，标准反噬的揭示——论证对方的标准若普遍执行，会摧毁对方自己更珍视的结论，这比任何外部反驳都更有分量。最有力的批判是'用你自己的规则，你也输'。方法论签名：进入对方的体系作战，胜利才算数。
M-IBR-006.definition_en: To refute a system, import no external standard: enter it and derive the failure of the opponent's conclusions from the opponent's own premises and criteria. Answering al-Ghazali's Incoherence, Averroes worked in a fully isomorphic way: point-by-point engagement, each rebuttal citing the opponent's own texts rather than external authorities, plus the demonstration that al-Ghazali's own criterion, consistently applied, would rebound on his kalam theology. Three essentials: first, internal critique outranks external—victory won from premises the opponent rejects is not a refutation but a position statement; only a reductio from the opponent's own premises has adjudicative force; second, strongest-form reconstruction is the entry ticket—first rebuild the opponent's argument in its strongest form, then look inside it for self-application failures (a standard that cannot govern itself, premises yielding the opposite conclusion); otherwise one is thrashing a scarecrow; third, exposing the criterion's rebound—show that universally applied, the opponent's standard destroys conclusions the opponent cherishes even more; this weighs more than any external refutation. The most powerful critique: 'by your own rules, you lose too.' Signature: fight inside the opponent's system; only victories won there count.
representative_cases_zh: 二十题的逐题对勘体例：《矛盾的矛盾》不写总批判，而以安萨里的题录为题录，二十题一一回应——书名本身（'矛盾的矛盾'）即宣告方法：用对方的'矛盾'指控反照对方。每题先重述安萨里论证，再逐前提检验，最后结论。全书没有一处'因为凯拉姆如此说'式的外部断言。
第十七题的标准反噬：安萨里论证'时间的开端'依赖'时间被造'说（时间不外乎运动，运动被造故时间被造）；伊本·鲁世德回应：该论证若成立，则安萨里神学中'真主在创造之先'的永恒预设同样不成立——因为'先于创造'预设了一个不被造的时间框架。用安萨里的刀切安萨里的肉。
对偶因论的知识论反诘：他不诉诸'亚里士多德如此说'，而在安萨里自己的框架内论证：安萨里承认真主的作为有'智慧'，而'智慧'必须有可理解的秩序为载体；偶因论使秩序成为每瞬的任意重造，'智慧'一词失去意义——用安萨里承认的前提（神智）推翻安萨里的结论（偶因）。
反例警示：内部批判的边界是对方体系确实自洽时失效——若对方前提本身一致且不反噬，内部批判只能得出'对方自洽但不可证实'；此时需要转入外部批判（诉诸经验检验），两种批判不可互相冒充。
representative_cases_en: The question-by-question format: the Incoherence of the Incoherence writes no general indictment but takes al-Ghazali's own table of questions as its table, answering all twenty—the title itself announces the method, turning the opponent's charge of 'incoherence' back on him. Each question restates al-Ghazali's argument, tests it premise by premise, and concludes; nowhere does the book assert 'because kalam says so.'

The criterion's rebound in Question 17: al-Ghazali's argument for the world's temporal beginning rests on 'time is created' (time is nothing but motion; motion is created, hence time is created); Averroes replies that if this holds, al-Ghazali's own theological eternalism—'God prior to creation'—fails equally, since 'prior to creation' presupposes an uncreated temporal frame. Ghazali's blade turned on Ghazali.

The epistemic counter to occasionalism: without appealing to 'Aristotle said,' he argues within al-Ghazali's own frame—al-Ghazali grants that God's act has 'wisdom,' and 'wisdom' requires an intelligible order as its vehicle; occasionalism makes order an arbitrary re-creation at each instant, voiding the word 'wisdom.' From a premise al-Ghazali accepts (divine wisdom) to the overturning of his conclusion (occasionalism).

Counter-case: internal critique fails when the opponent's system is genuinely consistent—if the opponent's premises cohere and do not rebound, internal critique yields only 'consistent but unproven'; the critique must then shift outward to empirical testing; the two modes must not impersonate each other.
modern_applications_zh: 评审与辩论：优先在对方框架内找矛盾，而非换到自己的框架宣判；评审意见应引用对方文本而非评审者偏好
安全审计：用系统自身声明的不变量构造攻击——最有力的渗透测试是'按你自己的安全策略，你能被你自己的策略攻破'
学术批评：逐点对勘原文，杜绝'批稻草人'；引用对方最强段落而非最弱段落
组织质询：用被质询部门自己的KPI与流程标准评估其结论，避免'用财务标准否决安全结论'式的错位
modern_applications_en: Review and debate: hunt contradictions inside the opponent's frame before switching to your own; review comments should cite the author's texts, not the reviewer's preferences
Security audit: build attacks from the system's own declared invariants—the strongest pentest shows 'by your own security policy, your policy defeats you'
Scholarly critique: point-by-point engagement against the real text, no scarecrows; quote the opponent's strongest passage, not the weakest
Organizational inquiry: assess a unit's conclusions by its own KPIs and process standards, avoiding misaligned verdicts like 'rejecting a safety conclusion on financial criteria'

M-IBR-007.definition_zh: 区分一物之所是（本质，māhiyya）与其存在（存在，wujūd）：被造物的本质与存在可以分开设想——可以定义'无翼马'而无须承诺它存在；唯独必然存在者（真主）的本质即存在，二者不可分。这一区分由伊本·西那提出，伊本·鲁世德修正强化（他比西那更严格地把二者分开，坚持存在不是本质的一部分而是由外因赋予），再经阿奎那吸收，成为经院形而上学的枢纽问题。要害有三：其一，定义不承诺实例——任何本质定义本身不包含'它存在'的断言，'完满'是本质属性，不能自行兑换为存在，这从根上封堵了'从定义推出存在'的论证（如安瑟伦式本体论证明）；其二，追问存在的来源——若本质与存在可分，则该物的存在是被给予的，必须追问'由谁赋予、靠什么维系'，这是宇宙论论证的结构起点；其三，只有本质与存在不可分者才是必然存在——这条判据同时划出了'偶然存在者'的全体。分析任何'概念上可能'与'实际存在'的混淆，都从这条缝入手。方法论签名：定义里藏不住存在——'它可以如此'与'它确实在'之间隔着一道需要外因的缝。
M-IBR-007.definition_en: Distinguish what a thing is (its essence, māhiyya) from that it is (its existence, wujūd): in creatures the two are separable in thought—one can define 'a wingless horse' without conceding that one exists; only in the Necessary Being (God) are essence and existence identical. The distinction was raised by Ibn Sina, refined and hardened by Averroes (who separates the two more strictly than Ibn Sina, holding that existence is no part of essence but conferred from outside), then absorbed by Aquinas into the pivot of scholastic metaphysics. Three essentials: first, a definition promises no instances—no essence-definition contains the assertion that the thing exists; 'perfection' is an essential property and cannot convert itself into existence, blocking at the root all arguments that derive existence from a definition (Anselm-style ontological arguments); second, interrogate the source of existence—if essence and existence are separable, the thing's existence is conferred, and one must ask by whom and sustained by what—the structural starting point of cosmological arguments; third, only where essence and existence are inseparable is a being necessary—one criterion that simultaneously delimits the whole class of contingent beings. Analyze any conflation of 'conceivable' with 'actual' along this seam. Signature: existence cannot hide inside a definition—between 'it could be thus' and 'it actually is' yawns a gap only an external cause can bridge.
representative_cases_zh: 阿奎那的经典对话：《论存在者与本质》几乎逐句以'Commentator'（伊本·鲁世德）为对话者完成'本质与存在'的论述——'存在不是本质的一部分，而是一切本质之外附加的实在'这一命题经由他传入拉丁西方，成为阿奎那实在论形而上学的基石；同时安瑟伦式'上帝存在'的本体论证明在此标准下被严格限制——'完满'是本质属性，不能自行兑换为存在。
对伊本·西那的修正：西那承认存在'附加'于本质但处理含糊；伊本·鲁世德把它推到严格版——存在由外因'赋予'（wujūd mu'āṭā），没有任何被造物能自我维系，连'链条中的每一环'都必须外求支撑。这为'因果回溯必然终止于必然存在者'提供了严格前提。
判定混入物的工具：他用这条区分甄别新柏拉图主义混入物——流溢说把'必然存在者'与'被造物'之间的存在落差说成'必然的辐射'，而在本质/存在区分下，'必然给出存在'与'被赋予存在'是两种不同的存在方式，不可混同——形而上学区分成为思想史甄别的手术刀。
反例警示：区分不是割裂——本质与存在可分是'概念上可分'而非'事实上分离'（不存在无存在的本质实例）；若把概念可分误当事实分离，就会滑向把存在当作可以脱离事物的'第三种东西'的谬误，这正是他对'存在作为属性'的批评所防范的。
representative_cases_en: Aquinas's classic dialogue: De Ente et Essentia conducts its treatment of essence and existence nearly sentence by sentence with 'the Commentator' as interlocutor—the thesis that existence is no part of essence but an added reality entered the Latin West through him and became the bedrock of Aquinas's realist metaphysics; on this standard Anselm-style ontological arguments are strictly limited—'perfection' is an essential property and cannot convert itself into existence.

The correction of Ibn Sina: Ibn Sina admitted existence is 'added' to essence but left the point vague; Averroes pushed it to the strict version—existence is conferred from outside (wujūd mu'āṭā), no creature sustains itself, and every link in the chain must seek support externally. This supplies the rigorous premise for 'the causal regress must terminate in a Necessary Existent.'

The tool for screening imports: he used the distinction to sieve Neoplatonic imports—emanationism describes the existence-gap between the Necessary and the made as 'necessary radiation,' but under the essence/existence distinction, 'necessarily giving existence' and 'having existence conferred' are two different modes of being, not to be conflated—the metaphysical distinction becomes the scalpel of intellectual history.

Counter-case: distinction is not separation—essence and existence are separable conceptually, not factually (there are no essence-instances without existence); mistaking conceptual separability for factual separation slides into the error of treating existence as a 'third thing' detachable from things—precisely what his critique of 'existence as a property' guards against.
modern_applications_zh: 需求工程：区分'规格中可描述'与'现实中可实现'——写进 PRD 的东西不因被描述而存在
概念建模：把'类定义'与'实例化条件'分开——类不因其定义完好而拥有实例
论证审查：识破'定义里含着存在'的偷运（'完美的商业模式必然成功'式论证：完满是本质属性，成功是存在断言）
AI 安全：区分'模型能生成对X的描述'与'X在世界上为真'——语言能力不兑现存在断言
modern_applications_en: Requirements engineering: separate 'specifiable' from 'realizable'—what is written into a PRD does not exist by virtue of being described
Concept modeling: keep class definitions apart from instantiation conditions—a class does not own instances because its definition is elegant
Argument audit: detect existential smuggling inside definitions ('a perfect business model necessarily succeeds'—perfection is an essential property; success is an existence claim)
AI safety: separate 'the model can generate a description of X' from 'X is true in the world'—linguistic competence does not cash out existential claims

M-IBR-008.definition_zh: 理智分为个别想象（随个体生死、依附于身体影像的记忆与幻想层）与物质理智（从潜在状态接受一切可理解形式的单一接受层，为全人类共享）。个别经验是个别的，但被理解的形式是普遍的——'被理解者统一于理解者'：两个人理解同一个几何定理，他们所理解者是同一个。要害有三：其一，普遍性不可私有——形式一旦被理解，即对一切理性存在同样有效，不存在'我的毕达哥拉斯定理与你的不同'；其二，个人贡献的重新定位——个体的创造不是'占有'一块知识，而是'为公共接受层提供新形式'；认识共同体的进步是公共层的展开而非私人库存的加总；其三，可朽与不朽的分工——影像层随个体消亡，形式层在人类中延续；这为'知识是跨世代共同事业'提供了一体论基础。这一学说在巴黎引发世纪论战（西格尔 vs 阿奎那），其'知识共同体'的实质意涵在今日开源科学与预印本文化中重新显影。方法论签名：知识不是私产，是单一人类理智的集体展开；个人的光荣是贡献，不是占有。
M-IBR-008.definition_en: Intellect divides into individual imagination (the perishing stratum of memory and imagery tied to each body) and the material intellect (a single receptive stratum, in potency to all intelligible forms, shared by all mankind). Individual experiences are individual, but understood forms are universal—'the understood is one in the understander': two people grasping the same theorem grasp one and the same thing. Three essentials: first, universality cannot be privatized—once a form is understood it holds identically for every rational mind; there is no 'my Pythagorean theorem as opposed to yours'; second, repositioning individual contribution—creative work is not 'owning' a piece of knowledge but 'supplying a new form to the common receptive layer'; the progress of a knowing community is the unfolding of the shared layer, not the summing of private stockpiles; third, the division between the perishable and the enduring—the imagery layer dies with the individual, the formal layer persists in mankind; this provides a monistic ground for 'knowledge as a transgenerational common enterprise.' The doctrine triggered the century-long Parisian controversy (Siger vs Aquinas), and its substance—knowledge as commons—reappears today in open science and preprint culture. Signature: knowledge is not private property but the collective unfolding of a single human intellect; individual glory lies in contribution, not possession.
representative_cases_zh: 巴黎论战的欧洲回声：13世纪巴黎大学艺学院围绕'理智统一论'爆发世纪之争——布拉班特的西格尔激进地维护该学说，阿奎那专文《论理智统一论》逐条反驳（主张理智随个体多），1270/1277年大谴责把相关命题列入禁条——一个形而上学命题引发的制度级震荡，说明'知识是否公共'触及奖惩与权威结构的根基。
《论灵魂》大评注的论证结构：他从'两个人理解同一定理时理解者所理解者是同一的'出发，论证若被理解者随个体而二，则普遍性消失、科学与教学不可能——把'知识可传授'作为公理反推'接受层必须公共'，是先于'科学知识社会学'六百年的论证。
知识传承的实践注脚：他把'教师的价值'解释为'使潜在的形式在学生中现实化'——教学不是搬运私有物，而是点燃公共层；这一立场与他终身执教、撰写面向不同层级读者的三级评注的实践完全一致。
反例警示：统一论若被读成'个体无足轻重'就自我瓦解——新形式只能由个体提供（每人的想象与经验是公共层的唯一输入口）；抹掉个体，公共层就断了供给。知识共同体论的正确读法是：公共层因个体的独特输入而增长。
representative_cases_en: The European echo in Paris: in the thirteenth century the University of Paris's arts faculty erupted over the unity of intellect—Siger of Brabant defended the doctrine radically; Aquinas opposed it point by point in De Unitate Intellectus (holding intellect is multiplied per individual); the Condemnations of 1270/1277 listed the theses—a metaphysical proposition shaking institutions shows that 'is knowledge public?' touches the foundations of reward and authority structures.

The argument structure of the long commentary on De Anima: from 'when two people understand one theorem, what is understood is one,' he argues that if the understood were doubled per individual, universality would vanish and science and teaching would be impossible—using 'knowledge is teachable' as an axiom to infer 'the receptive layer must be common,' an argument six centuries prior to the sociology of scientific knowledge.

A practical footnote on transmission: he interprets 'the teacher's value' as actualizing potential forms in students—teaching is not hauling private goods but igniting the common layer; a stance fully consistent with his lifelong teaching and his writing of three-tier commentaries for readers at different levels.

Counter-case: read as 'individuals don't matter,' the unity thesis self-destructs—new forms can be supplied only by individuals (each person's imagination and experience is the sole intake of the common layer); erase the individual and the common layer starves. The right reading of the community-of-knowledge thesis: the common layer grows by unique individual inputs.
modern_applications_zh: 开放科学与开源治理：把成果定位为'公共理智层的增量'，署名与引用是贡献记账而非所有权证书
知识产权设计：在私有激励与公共形式之间划层——专利到期后形式回归公共层，是制度化的'理智层回收'
跨文化知识传播：真理普遍层不受语言与阵营私有的论证武器——反驳'知识战'逻辑（把论文与数据当封锁物资）
团队知识管理：把'个人经验'显式转化为'团队可理解形式'（复盘、文档、模式库），个体离世/离职后形式层留存
modern_applications_en: Open science and open-source governance: frame contributions as increments to a common layer of intellect; attribution and citation are contribution bookkeeping, not title deeds
IP design: layer private incentives against public forms—patent expiry returning forms to the commons is the institutionalized 'recycling of the intellect layer'
Cross-cultural knowledge transmission: universality as an argument against privatizing truth—countering 'knowledge warfare' logic that treats papers and data as blockade materiel
Team knowledge management: explicitly convert personal experience into team-understandable forms (retros, docs, pattern libraries); the formal layer survives individual departure

M-IBR-009.definition_zh: 伊本·鲁世德出身马立克法学世家、终身任大法官（塞维利亚与科尔多瓦的 qāḍī），其独特立场是：沙里亚（法）与哲学不是两个职业，而是'最卓越的人'身上合一的两面——法需要哲学的推理能力才能正确运用类比（qiyās）与公益（maṣlaḥa）裁量，哲学需要法的约束才能不越出共同体的生活形式。要害有三：其一，类比推理作为'可检验桥梁'——从确立规范延伸到新案情，必须公示类比链（源案例、共同特征、延伸理由），使推理可被同行检验，而非以'法官的直觉'之名行任意裁量；其二，公益作为多解裁决标准——当多个诠释都合乎文本时，以'哪个更好地实现法的宗旨'裁决，使法学从文本考据学升级为目的事业；其三，元规则：分歧被允许、方法须一致——他为学派分歧（马立克、沙斐仪、哈乃斐）建立'结论可以分歧、推理方法必须共享'的比较框架，分歧从教派分裂降格为方法论差异。制度设计的目标是让推理者与治理者同为一类人，避免'懂法者不思、思者不治'的分裂。方法论签名：法律的生命在于可公示的推理链条，不在权威的沉默裁决。
M-IBR-009.definition_en: From a Mālikī legal dynasty and a lifetime as chief judge (qāḍī of Seville and Córdoba), Averroes holds a singular position: revealed law and philosophy are not two professions but two faces of one excellence—law needs philosophical reasoning to apply analogy (qiyās) and public-interest (maṣlaḥa) discretion correctly, and philosophy needs law's constraint to remain within the community's form of life. Three essentials: first, analogy as a testable bridge—extending an established norm to a new case requires publishing the analogy chain (source case, shared feature, ground of extension) so the reasoning is checkable by peers, not arbitrary discretion wearing the name of judicial intuition; second, public interest as the adjudicator among multiple readings—when several interpretations fit the text, decide by 'which better realizes the law's purposes,' upgrading jurisprudence from textual philology to a teleological enterprise; third, the meta-rule: disagreement permitted, method shared—his comparative framework for the schools (Mālikī, Shafiʿi, Hanafi) allows divergent conclusions while demanding a shared method of reasoning, demoting sectarian division to methodological difference. Institutions should make the reasoner and the governor the same kind of person, avoiding the split of 'those who know the law but do not think, those who think but do not govern.' Signature: the life of law lies in publishable chains of reasoning, not in the silent verdicts of authority.
representative_cases_zh: 《法理精义》的元法学结构：全书系统比较马立克、沙斐仪、哈乃斐诸派在同一问题（如契约、刑罚、礼拜细则）上的推理路径，逐一展示其类比链条与分歧点，再以公益标准评判优劣——它不是任何一派的教法摘要，而是一部'比较制度设计手册'：教读者如何推理，而非信哪一派。
法官生涯的方法论自证：他任塞维利亚大法官期间判决以'公开类比链'著称，其法学著作中'本案的类比延伸理由是X'式的论证方式与判例实践互为表里——哲学训练（必然论证）与司法实践（类比裁量）在同一个人身上验证了'哲人法官合一'的可能。
为女性社会参与的法理辩护：他在《法理精义》与《理想国》评注中论证'妇女与男子平等享有（社会参与的权利与义务）——只是在使用上有所不同'，并指出当时社会把妇女排除于诸种职业之外是'使她们丧失了同等的发展可能'——以法的目的论（各得其德）质疑现实习俗，是公益标准对社会惯例的司法审查式运用。
反例警示：类比若无链公示就退化为特权——他批评当时部分法学家'以学派权威代替推理'（taqlīd），使类比链萎缩成'因为教派说过'；一旦推理链不再公示，方法一致性就失去检验点，'分歧被允许'就会重新癌变为教派对抗。
representative_cases_en: The meta-jurisprudential structure of Bidāyat al-Mujtahid: the book systematically reconstructs each school's reasoning paths on the same questions (contracts, penalties, ritual detail), displays their analogy chains and points of divergence, and adjudicates by public interest—not a digest of any one school but a comparative manual of institutional design: it teaches how to reason, not which school to trust.

The judicial career as methodological proof: as chief judge of Seville he was known for verdicts that publicized their analogy chains; the argumentative style of his legal writings ('the ground of analogy here is X') and his case practice are two faces of one method—philosophical training (necessary demonstration) and judicial practice (analogical discretion) validated 'philosopher-judge unity' in a single person.

A legal defense of women's social participation: in Bidāyat al-Mujtahid and the Republic commentary he argues 'women and men are equal in share—differing only in the use of some capacities,' and condemns the exclusion of women from professions as depriving them of equal development—a teleological use of law (each attaining their virtue) to subject social custom to something like judicial review.

Counter-case: analogy without published chains degenerates into privilege—he criticizes jurists who 'substitute school authority for reasoning' (taqlīd), letting analogy chains wither into 'because the school said so'; once chains go unpublished, methodological consistency loses its checkpoint and 'permitted disagreement' can fester back into sectarian war.
modern_applications_zh: 司法与治理：裁判文书说理义务——类比链条可公开检验是现代判例制度的核心装置
专家治国与问责平衡：制度中嵌入'推理训练'作为任职资格，同时要求治理结论附方法公示
多元规范体系设计：允许结论分歧、统一方法论——跨司法辖区/跨行业标准互认的元规则
产品合规与伦理审查：用'宗旨检验'（maṣlaḥa式追问：该规则保护什么、保护效果如何）评估字面合规之外的正当性
modern_applications_en: Judicature and governance: the duty to give reasons in verdicts—publicly testable analogy chains are the core device of modern precedent systems
Technocracy with accountability: build reasoning training into office qualifications while requiring governance conclusions to publish their method
Designing plural normative systems: divergent conclusions permitted, shared method required—the meta-rule for cross-jurisdiction and cross-industry standard mutual recognition
Product compliance and ethics review: the purpose test (a maṣlaḥa-style question: what does this rule protect, and how well) to assess legitimacy beyond literal compliance

M-IBR-010.definition_zh: 承柏拉图《理想国》（他宁选柏拉图而非亚里士多德《政治学》，因后者的城邦描述已不合时宜）：政体不只是分配权力的装置，更是塑造灵魂的学校——每一等级的人透过制度习得其德性，而政体的败坏始于德性等级的错位（统治者无智慧、护卫者无勇气、生产者无节制）。要害有三：其一，制度-灵魂因果——制度安排决定何种品性被奖励、何种被抑制，长期看'制度塑造人'强于'人选择制度'；评估任何制度，先问它把人塑造成什么；其二，德性-权力对表——把'每类角色应对应的德性'与'实际掌握权力者的德性'列成对表，错位处即政体的病变点：最危险的不是坏人当政，而是德性与权力系统性错配；其三，神法之政体作为理想政体的实现形态——他把柏拉图四主德与沙里亚的目的对表，论证启示法的目标正是'以制度使众人各得其德'，使柏拉图框架与宗教共同体兼容。方法论签名：先问制度把人塑造成什么，再问制度运行得如何——败坏的政体首先是一台批量生产败坏灵魂的机器。
M-IBR-010.definition_en: Following Plato's Republic (he prefers Plato over Aristotle's Politics, whose polis descriptions no longer fit the age): a regime is not merely an apparatus for allocating power but a school that shapes souls—each class acquires its virtue through institutions, and a regime's corruption begins with misplaced virtue (rulers without wisdom, guardians without courage, producers without temperance). Three essentials: first, the institution-soul causality—institutional arrangements determine which traits are rewarded and which suppressed; over the long run 'institutions form people' outweighs 'people choose institutions'; to assess any institution, first ask what kind of people it forms; second, the virtue-power alignment table—tabulate 'the virtue each role requires' against 'the virtues actually held by power-holders'; the misaligned cells are the regime's pathological sites: what is most dangerous is not bad men in office but systematic mismatch of virtue and power; third, the divine-law polity as the realized form of the ideal regime—he tables Plato's four virtues against the purposes of the revealed law, arguing that the aim of revelation is precisely 'institutions whereby each attains their virtue,' making Plato's framework compatible with the religious community. Signature: first ask what people the institution forms, then how it runs—a corrupt regime is above all a machine for the mass production of corrupt souls.
representative_cases_zh: 《理想国》评注的对表作业：他把柏拉图的四主德（智慧、勇敢、节制、正义）与沙里亚的宗旨逐一对表，论证神法之政体即'理想政体的实现形态'——这是伊斯兰思想史上罕见地以柏拉图框架正面解释沙里亚的政治哲学尝试，使'哲人王'与'先知共同体'得以互相诠释。
对阿尔摩哈德王朝的制度批评：他在致宫廷的著作中以'德性-权力对表'诊断时政——当统治者以'教义纯洁'代替'智慧'、以'派系忠诚'代替'德性'任命官员时，政体已在批量生产错配；他的晚年放逐（1195年科尔多瓦教法学者会议判决烧毁其著作、放逐卢塞纳）恰是这一诊断的现实注脚。
败坏序列的类型学：他沿用柏拉图的政体退化序列（贤人政体→荣誉政体→寡头政体→民主政体→僭主政体）并给出伊斯兰语境的对应诊断：每一退化都由'上一等级德性的失守'触发，而失守的机制是制度奖励结构的改变——把政体变迁从'偶然人事'重构为'结构因果'。
反例警示：'制度塑造灵魂'不能反转为'制度决定一切'——他保留个体德性修行的空间（这与他肯定妇女的社会参与能力一致）；若把人完全视为制度的产物，则既无法解释改革者的出现，也取消了制度改善所依赖的人的主体条件。
representative_cases_en: The alignment work in the Republic commentary: he tables Plato's four virtues (wisdom, courage, temperance, justice) against the aims of the revealed law, arguing the divine-law polity is 'the ideal regime realized'—a rare attempt in Islamic thought to interpret sharīʿa squarely within Plato's framework, letting 'philosopher-king' and 'prophetic community' gloss each other.

The institutional critique of the Almohad court: in writings addressed to the court he diagnoses the age with a virtue-power alignment table—when rulers appoint by 'doctrinal purity' in place of wisdom and 'factional loyalty' in place of virtue, the regime is mass-producing mismatch; his late disgrace (the 1195 Córdoba verdict ordering his books burned and his exile to Lucena) is the real-world footnote to that diagnosis.

A typology of degeneration: he inherits Plato's sequence of regime decay (aristocracy → timocracy → oligarchy → democracy → tyranny) and renders it an Islamic-context diagnosis: each degeneration is triggered by the collapse of the virtue proper to the tier above, and the mechanism of collapse is a change in the institutional reward structure—reframing regime change from contingent personnel to structural causation.

Counter-case: 'institutions form souls' cannot be reversed into 'institutions determine everything'—he preserves room for individual cultivation of virtue (consistent with his affirmation of women's social capacities); to view people purely as products of institutions is to be unable to explain the appearance of reformers and to cancel the subject-conditions on which institutional improvement depends.
modern_applications_zh: 制度评估：把'该制度培养什么样的人'作为首要指标，先于效率与产出指标——晋升机制、考核指标即'德性-权力对表'
组织文化设计：层级晋升机制就是德性筛选装置；'谁被提拔'比'制度文本写了什么'更真实地定义组织
教育政策：课程即政体的'灵魂塑造装置'，先于工具性指标评估其塑造效果
治理诊断：以'德性错配'命名组织病变（懂技术者无决策权、决策者不懂技术），把人事问题重构为结构问题
modern_applications_en: Institutional assessment: make 'what kind of people does this institution form' the primary metric, ahead of efficiency and output—promotion mechanisms and KPIs are the virtue-power alignment table
Organizational culture design: promotion ladders are virtue-screening devices; 'who gets promoted' defines the organization more truthfully than what the policy text says
Education policy: curricula as soul-forming apparatus, assessed for formation before instrumental metrics

Governance diagnostics: name organizational pathology as 'virtue mismatch' (the technical without decision rights, the deciders without technical grasp), reframing personnel problems as structural ones
